from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Extracted cash flow data for a single company from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company (e.g., 深圳市振业 (集团) 股份有限公司)")
    cash_paid_to_employees: float | None = Field(description="Amount of 'Cash paid to and on behalf of employees' (支付给职工以及为职工支付的现金) in Yuan")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of the cash flow statement (e.g., '2025-01 to 2025-03')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extracted data from the collection of documents."""
    company_cash_flows: list[CompanyCashFlow]
